leo: Ran onboarding eval for fjord-embed-3-small (fp16) vs sable-v1 on our short-anchors set. Saw a reproducible recall@1 regression concentrated on queries <=12 tokens.

amina: top-line?

leo: sable-v1 | fjord-3-small
leo: recall@1 0.71 | 0.64
leo: recall@5 0.85 | 0.79
leo: mean pos cosine 0.75 | 0.69

dev-bot: job queued: eval-1732109999 on eng-ml-gpu-2

amina: did you check tokenizer differences? fjord has a byte tweak that might change first-token bias.

leo: yep. forced sable-tokenizer on fjord run -> recall@1 up to 0.67. also tried L2 vs cosine: normalizing vectors before NN recovered another ~0.02.

amina: what about quantization? int8 per-channel?

leo: int8 per-channel on 2k sample -> recall@1 0.61. per-tensor was worse (0.58). artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/artifacts/1732109999

ops-bot: @leo scheduled gpu job 1732110000 for 30m on eng-ml-gpu-2.

leo: short synthesis: tokenization mismatch ~0.03-0.04, quantization ~0.03-0.05, residual gap likely capacity. But fjord-small p50 latency 10ms vs sable 19ms and ~40% lower cost.

amina: pragmatic options: (A) use fjord-3-medium for public search, (B) fjord-3-small int8 for low-latency internal features, with fallback routing for short queries.

leo: I'll run fjord-3-medium with sable-tokenizer + per-channel int8 on full 12k to confirm. Also adding a short-query holdout (10%) to the eval pipeline for automated alerts.

amina: add a quick token-alignment shim test too (map tokens -> sable ids and re-run embed) to see if we can avoid re-training.

leo: command I used initially:
```
python evals/run.py --model fjord-embed-3-small --corpus data/short-anchors-12k.jsonl --k 1,5,10 --batch 256 --quant fp16
```

dev-bot: run completed: eval-1732110000 logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/1732110000

leo: interim: fjord-3-medium + sable-tokenizer + norming -> recall@1 0.69 (fp16), int8 per-channel -> 0.66. Will open RFC in product/rollouts with recommended canary thresholds and artifact links.

amina: nice. please include UMAP snapshots and per-length recall curves. tag me when RFC is up.

leo: will do, thanks :)
